system.description: You induce a preternatural degree of guilt or fear in a subject, forcing a torrential sweat of blood from every pore. You must be within line of sight of the subject and spend three turns (or fifteen seconds out of combat) in concentration, then issue a Mental Challenge which the target resists with Physical Traits. You may risk any number of your Mental Traits in this challenge. If you win, make a Simple Test for each Mental Trait you risked; for each Simple Test you win or tie, the target loses one Blood Trait (or takes one level of lethal damage if mortal) as blood pours from his skin. The blood lost is dead and inert, providing only half sustenance if consumed. The victim also experiences an overwhelming compulsion — guilt-wracked confession or boastful bragging depending on temperament — left to Storyteller discretion.
